breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified that for a 2D simulation in the XY plane where height is along the Y-axis, gravity must also act along the Y-axis. It changed the gravity vector from the incorrect -Z direction to the correct `(0 -9.81 0)` direction.
